craft_notes: Sthāyin: Longing to see and stay; vow. Sthāyin: praise of seers. Device: end-dash→colon (dreamers stated, gift lands). Rejected: 'dreamers' noun for dream-caught — killed: participle kept (fork-work honored). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail to them, yea, who dream-caught the crescent-crowned:
the Lord, the giver of unbound delight.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namas tebhyo 'pi ye somakalākalitaśekharam nāthaṃ svapne 'pi paśyanti paramānandadāyinam

reads_against.argmap: Homage to them even: who see the moon-crescent-crowned lord even in dream.; The giver of supreme bliss. → Homage to those who see the bliss-giving lord even in dreams.
c1_essence: Longing to see the deep and dwell in the cave; homage to dream-seers of the bliss-giver.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)
reads_against.l2: Homage to them even — who see the moon-crested lord, giver of supreme bliss, even in dream.
l3: Hail to them, yea, who dream-caught the crescent-crowned —
the Lord, the giver of unbound delight.
reads_against.t1: Homage even to those who see in dream the lord, moon-crescent-crowned, giver of supreme bliss.
